description: This file defines the 'MD' type for ttrpc metadata handling, including methods for getting, setting, appending, cloning metadata, and attaching/retrieving metadata from context objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the metadata list for a given key, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the provided values for a key, overwriting existing values or deleting the key if no values are provided.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends values to an existing key's list of values.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the MD metadata map.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Attaches metadata to a Request object.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Populates metadata from a Request object.
